content.text:
The dropdown bug and the missing borders had one cause. The test builder was written for Docusaurus and uses its colour variables, which the new site maps to Maester's colours in `site.css`. That file is only loaded on pages outside the docs, and the builder is a docs page. So on that page every border, and the dropdown's background, had no colour: no field outlines, and the option list was see-through.

**Fixes**
- **Colours:** I moved that mapping into [theme.css](website/src/styles/theme.css), which every page loads. Fields have borders again and dropdowns have a solid background, in light and dark mode.
- **Less help text in the form:** each field now shows only its label, an "Optional" marker where it applies, a small **?** button, the input and any errors. The description, "How to choose" rubric, "Not in the list?" notes and the Control field's numbered steps all moved into a help panel that slides in from the side. Two other sections work the same way: "Rate the test, not your tenant" and "Why is there no Tag field?".
- **Help panel:** the panel doesn't lock the page. You can keep picking values while you read the rubric, clicking another field's **?** switches the panel to that field, and Esc or × closes it.
- **Layout:** the builder used to switch to two columns based on the window width, so at about 1000px the form was squeezed into a narrow strip beside the sidebar. It now switches based on its own width, and below about 900px it uses one column.

**Where the panel opens:** I put it on the right, not the left you suggested. When the form and code are side by side, it covers only the code column, so the field you're asking about stays in view. A panel from the left would cover the sidebar and the left edge of the form, including the field labels. In one-column layouts it slides over the right side of the form. If you'd still prefer the left, it's a small change.

I checked it in the browser in light and dark mode at 1024px and 1440px, and there were no console errors. I also removed some old CSS rules that were left over from an earlier version and were pushing the "Optional" marker into the middle of the row. The main changes are in [index.jsx](website/src/components/TestBuilder/index.jsx), [ui.jsx](website/src/components/TestBuilder/ui.jsx) and the two CSS modules. Nothing is committed yet.
